claims.text: The fine-tuned legal embedding LLM achieves a 13% improvement in Hit Rate.
The fine-tuned legal embedding LLM achieves a 15% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
The Hybrid Fine-Tuned Generative LLM (HFM) yields a 24% performance gain compared to general LLMs.
LQ-RAG achieves a 23% improvement in relevance score over naive configurations.
LQ-RAG achieves a 14% improvement in relevance score over RAG with Fine-Tuned LLMs (FTM).
Legal Query RAG (LQ-RAG) incorporates a custom evaluation agent, specialized response generation model, prompt engineering agent, fine-tuned legal embedding LLM, and recursive feedback mechanism.

evidence.description: Experimental results demonstrate that the fine-tuned embedding LLM achieves a 13% improvement in Hit Rate.
Experimental results demonstrate that the fine-tuned embedding LLM achieves a 15% improvement in Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
Comparisons with general LLMs reveal a 24% performance gain when using the Hybrid Fine-Tuned Generative LLM (HFM).
LQ-RAG achieves a 23% improvement in relevance score over naive configurations.
LQ-RAG achieves a 14% improvement over RAG with Fine-Tuned LLMs (FTM).
The proposed framework incorporates four key components: a custom evaluation agent, a specialized response generation model, a prompt engineering agent, and a fine-tuned legal embedding LLM.

methodologies.name: Legal Query RAG (LQ-RAG)
methodologies.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework with recursive feedback mechanism integrating an evaluation agent, fine-tuned generative LLM, prompt engineering agent, and fine-tuned embedding LLM.

limitations.text: Standard RAG implementations struggle with understanding complex legal reasoning, managing biased data, ensuring transparency, and avoiding hallucinations.
The study relies on a proprietary model as the evaluation agent.
The evaluation lacks feedback from human domain experts.

future_work.text: Developing a specialized legal evaluation agent.
Enhancing performance by incorporating feedback from domain experts.
